# Cartographic Brief: The Known Galaxy

**Date:** 2026-10-29
**Phases:** 0, 0b, and 1 of the [atlas map plan](../../docs/ATLAS_MAP_PLAN_2026_10_29.md)
**Sketch:** [`layout_sketch_v1.svg`](layout_sketch_v1.svg), generated by
`node design/map/make_sketch.js design/map/layout_sketch_v1.svg`

This brief records the author's map decisions and turns them into placement
rules. Its claim register (section 4) and drawing rules (section 5) are
encoded in the placement file, `design/map/cartography.yaml`, and checked by
`npm run lint:map`. Every question raised so far is answered; nothing in this brief rests
on an unapproved inference. It reflects `main` after PRs #45 and #46.

## 1. Authority

- The author accepted the ten first-pass recommendations (D1–D10) and the
  twenty-one second-pass recommendations (Q1–Q21) on 2026-10-29.
- **Approved** claims in section 4 are working canon. They are topology:
  containment, adjacency, and radial order. **Canon** claims were already
  established and are cited.
- Geometry is cartographic interpretation, *P.A.* (position approximate).
  That covers every radius, angle, size, shape, and drawn count in
  section 3 and in the sketch.
- Primary canon outranks this brief. If a later primary-canon story
  contradicts an approved claim, the story stands and the claim is revised.
- A claim about a speculative entity governs the author build only. It binds
  canon when that entity is approved. `lore/COSMIC_REGIONS.md` §7 states the
  approved arrangement in prose and leaves speculative entities out.
- No entity's `canon_tier` or `metadata.status` changed because of this
  brief.

## 2. Decisions

### First pass (D1–D10)

| # | Decision |
|---|----------|
| D1 | Topology is working canon. Geometry stays cartographic and carries *P.A.* notes. The map never becomes primary canon on its own authority. |
| D2 | **Shape:** a spiral disk whose arms carry the density gradient. **Layout:** the Core at the center; the Drift as a galactic belt whose outer sleeve is a sparse deep-orbit ring; the Lattice Gap as a rift at the Lattice's outer reach, its outer sleeve touching a Void Region; the Remnant Seas as pockets beyond the Drift; Voids scattered, densest at the margins; the Black Horizon as the perimeter, its interior uncharted. Q1 amends how the Gap meets the Drift. |
| D3 | A 2D chart is the canonical artifact. An optional 2.5D gravity-well view may follow. No z-coordinates. |
| D4 | Heavonly sits at the Drift–Core boundary, in the author build only. No other galaxies are drawn until the novel settles the count. |
| D5 | **Sleeve:** a band of any region, named relative to the region's inward edge. The Drift's outer sleeve holds nine numbered sleeves, counted outward. **Pull:** a count of drive engagements, never converted to distance or time. Both are lexicon `draft` terms. |
| D6 | Solace Hospice at the Gap–Void contact; Ostra-Vael on a Seas boundary; black-hole knots; Ebbhaven *E.D.*; Halix on a circuit through the outer sleeve; the Vault at the outer sleeve's inner edge; "the Tides" is not a mapped region. |
| D7 | **Two builds.** The author build shows every tier, with speculative entities faded. The public build includes only primary and working canon, and excludes draft data at build time. Halix and Skather-Ait received their source-first review in PR #45 and are now primary canon. |
| D8 | The author build is private, on the VPS behind basic auth. The public build launches with a reader-facing occasion. Public panels carry summaries only. |
| D9 | Procedural art first; judge a style frame after Phase 2. A commissioned hero map, if wanted, is work made for hire with an assignment backstop. No AI plates. |
| D10 | A placement is required at promotion (playbook Step 6b), not at drafting. Drafting agents may propose a placement in the PR body but do not edit the placement file. After the Phase 1 backfill, CI errors on an unplaced primary-canon location and warns on a speculative one. A placement change is a Canon Impact line. |

| Q16 | Heavonly: `region: Helios Drift inner sleeve`. Skather-Ait: `region: Helios Drift outer sleeve`. Solace Hospice: `region: Lattice Gap outer sleeve`. No densities are invented. |

## 3. Chart Frame (geometry, all *P.A.*)

Coordinates are unitless polar values. *r* is the chart radius, with 1.0 at
the Black Horizon's near edge. *θ* is degrees counterclockwise from the
chart's right-hand side. No distance is implied.

| Zone | *r* |
|------|-----|
| Mnemosyne Lattice Core | 0 – 0.12 |
| Helios Drift: inner sleeve | 0.12 – 0.28 |
| Helios Drift: mid-sleeve | 0.28 – 0.45 |
| Helios Drift: outer sleeve, numbered sleeves I–IX of equal width, counted outward | 0.45 – 0.62 |
| Beyond the Drift: Gap, Seas, Voids | 0.62 – 1.00 |
| Black Horizon; far edge uncharted | 1.00 – 1.20+ |

Every placement now lives in `design/map/cartography.yaml`, the single
source for positions, shapes, features, routes, and the relations of
section 4. `npm run lint:map` checks it against canon. Building the
placement file moved four positions from the sketch: Heavonly to r 0.124 (the
Drift's inner edge), Skather-Ait pod to r 0.535, θ 293 (Halix's unnumbered
mid-band ring, per R3), Ostra-Vael to θ 165 (exactly on its pocket's edge),
and the Void beside Solace to r 0.90, θ 54 (so that it touches the Gap's outer
sleeve, per T18).

## 5. Drawing Rules

| ID | Rule | Basis |
|----|------|-------|
| R1 | All geometry is *P.A.* | D1 |
| R2 | Counts of drawn features (arms, pockets, Voids, black-hole knots) carry no canon weight. A feature canon gives no count for is drawn as one labeled line or area, not as individual markers. | Q8 |
| R3 | A site inside the outer sleeve without a canon sleeve number is drawn mid-band. Its sub-band asserts nothing. | Q6 |
| R4 | Routes show only the legs canon gives, labeled with canon pull counts. *The Archivist's Wake* is an approach into the Gap marked "3 pulls," with no origin. The Vault–inner relay leg is "2 pulls." | Q9; `ss/the_archivists_wake:131`; `ss/spend_what_you_can_afford:903` |
| R5 | Unnamed Sleeves I, III, VI, and VIII show numerals only. The Fourth Sleeve's population stays blank. | Q12 |
| R6 | Soundings show only canon values. The Vault and the Drift carry "pre-breach" and read "unmeasured" after the breach. | Plan §2.1 |
| R7 | Speculative entities appear only in the author build, faded. | D7 |
| R8 | The universe-level dark-matter scaffold is unlabeled. | Q13 |
| R9 | The Fourth and Ninth Sleeves draw as softening after the breach. No figure is attached. | `atlas/Helios_Drift.md` |

values fall strictly with radius:

> Core 0.97 > Drift 0.65 > Gap 0.31 > Seas 0.04 > Horizon 0.01

The Voids are holes at 0.00. Sites may peak above their surroundings.
